content.text:
Start at https://www.webmd.com/ and complete the following task by navigating within that website.

Search for the ovulation calculator and enter Mar 1 as the first date of the period and calculate the date of ovulation and pregnancy test day.

Rules:
- Work entirely in this one browser tab. Do NOT open new tabs.
- Do NOT use a search engine (Google, Bing, etc.) or cached/archived copies (e.g. web.archive.org). Navigate the site itself, starting from https://www.webmd.com/.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

n and continuing for 2 to 3 days after you think you've ovulated.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003ELie low after sex?\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EIt was long believed that you should stay in bed for at least 15 minutes after sex to give sperm a chance to reach the egg. But recent studies found no evidence to back up this claim.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EMaintain a healthy weight\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EStudies show that weighing too little – or too much – may disrupt ovulation and cycle length and affect the production of key hormones. Doctors consider a healthy body mass index to be between 18.5 and 24.9. Staying fit with moderate exercise is fine, but this isn’t the time to train for a marathon: Strenuous exercise can mess with your menstrual cycle, making it more difficult for you to conceive.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EDe-stress\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003EResearch shows that stress may make it harder to get pregnant. Yoga, meditation, and long walks can help lower stress and improve your overall well-being.\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EManage medical conditions\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EIf you have a medical condition such as diabetes, \\u003Ca href=\\\"https:\\u002F\\u002Fwww.webmd.com\\u002Fasthma\\u002Fwhat-is-asthma\\\" crosslinktype=\\\"Article\\\" crosslinksource=\\\"ICLT\\\"\\u003Easthma\\u003C\\u002Fa\\u003E, or \\u003Ca href=\\\"https:\\u002F\\u002Fwww.webmd.com\\u002Fepilepsy\\u002Funderstanding-epilepsy-basics\\\" crosslinktype=\\\"Article\\\" crosslinksource=\\\"ICLT\\\"\\u003Eepilepsy\\u003C\\u002Fa\\u003E, be sure it’s under control. Speak with your doctor about any prescription or over-the-counter medications you may be taking, since they might affect your chances of getting pregnant.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EYour partner's health matters, too\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EMore than 33% of fertility issues involve only the sperm-producing partner, and another 33% involve both partners. Either partner can improve their reproductive health by quitting smoking, limiting alcohol, eating healthy, and lowering stress.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003ETrying for a boy or a girl?\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003ESeveral theories claim you can influence the gender of your baby by having sex at a certain time of the month or in a specific position. ovulate\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EOvulation is thought to happen about 14 days before your next period begins, but it can vary from month to month – even if you have regular cycles. To get a better sense of when you’re ovulating, chart your basal body temperature and your cervical mucus. Use an over-the-counter ovulation predictor kit, ovulation tracking bracelet, or lab tests to check for hormonal changes before ovulation\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E.\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EHave sex often\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EYour odds of getting pregnant are best when you have sex 1 to 2 days before you ovulate. But cycle length can vary. You may have an irregular cycle or miscalculate your ovulation date. \\u003Ca href=\\\"https:\\u002F\\u002Fwww.webmd.com\\u002Finfertility-and-reproduction\\u002Fsperm-and-semen-faq\\\" crosslinktype=\\\"Article\\\" crosslinksource=\\\"ICLT\\\"\\u003ESperm\\u003C\\u002Fa\\u003E can survive in your body for up to 5 days. To hedge your bets, have sex often starting 3 days before ovulation and continuing for 2 to 3 days after you think you've ovulated.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003ELie low after sex?\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EIt was long believed that you should stay in bed for at least 15 minutes after sex to give sperm a chance to reach the egg. But recent studies found no evidence to back up this claim.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EMaintain a healthy weight\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003E\\u003Cspan\\u003EStudies show that weighing too little – or too much – may disrupt ovulation and cycle length and affect the production of key hormones. Doctors consider a healthy body mass index to be between 18.5 and 24.9. Staying fit with moderate exercise is fine, but this isn’t the time to train for a marathon: Strenuous exercise can mess with your menstrual cycle, making it more difficult for you to conceive.\\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fli\\u003E\\u003Cli\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003EDe-stress\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003Cbr \\u002F\\u003EResearch shows that stress may make it harder to get pregnant.
